route: Goal -> Provisional Plan -> Current Minimum Need -> Capability Requirement -> Governed Capability Candidate -> Evidence/Outcome -> State Version -> Sufficiency/Reconsideration -> Next Step
semantic_freezes: Plan completeness is not execution completeness
Invocation Candidate is not guaranteed execution
New evidence may invalidate or supersede remaining candidates
Only the current minimum necessary Need may become downstream demand
Goal sufficiency may terminate the remaining path
skipped or not-required calls are not capability failures
capability failure does not imply task failure
requirements are reassessed against their generating state version
safety priority cannot bypass scope, authority, or sufficiency governance
